title: OverflowMapUntypedValue
description: Issue #137: an overflow map typed from a sub-schema that states no "type" asserts what the schema did not say. `minimum` constrains numbers and is vacuous for every other JSON kind, so map[string]float64 refused a string and an object in the decoder and measured a null's Go zero against the bound. The same narrowing follows from minLength (string), minItems (array) and required (object). Each position here is checked in both spellings of the overflow map -- the struct field beside declared properties, and the Go map an all-additionalProperties object becomes -- with a sub-schema that does state its type as the control that must keep narrowing.

bare.$comment: The reported shape as a Go map: no declared key, one schema for every value.

typed.$comment: The accept-control: the sub-schema states its type, so the narrowing is authorized and a wrong-typed value really is a rejection.

viaRef.$comment: The same untyped sub-schema written as a $defs entry, which has always got the wrapper. The inline spelling must now agree with it.
